info.title: Gremion content module — publish lifecycle events
info.description: Lifecycle events emitted by the content module (which lives in the module repo, not here) after each publish attempt and per-channel dispatch. Five events: publish.succeeded, publish.failed, channel.email.sent, channel.portal.sent, channel.instagram.enqueued. Subject grammar: gremion.{tenantId}.content.{event} — built by contentSubject() in @gremion/ports/broker (single source of truth for the wire subject). EventEnvelope field-matched to packages/ports/src/broker.ts EventEnvelope interface. JetStream mapping: Nats-Msg-Id = envelope.eventId. The relay publishes; its audit consumer — which lives in the module repo, not here — subscribes on gremion.*.content.> (6+ token subjects). The AsyncAPI channel address is verified at test time against contentSubject() — see packages/ports/src/content-contract.test.ts assertion.

gremion.{tenantId}.content.publish.succe.description: Published when all channels for a content post complete successfully. Subject built by contentSubject(tenantId, 'publish.succeeded') — never construct the subject string directly.

tenantId.description: Tenant UUID; resolved by UUID (#173 global constraint) — no slug-based routing.

gremion.{tenantId}.content.publish.faile.description: Published when a content post publish attempt fails terminally (after all channel attempts). Subject built by contentSubject(tenantId, 'publish.failed').

gremion.{tenantId}.content.channel.email.description: Published when the email channel dispatch for a content post completes successfully. Subject built by contentSubject(tenantId, 'channel.email.sent').

gremion.{tenantId}.content.channel.porta.description: Published when the portal channel dispatch for a content post completes successfully (news post created/updated via kernel portal-publish callback). Subject built by contentSubject(tenantId, 'channel.portal.sent').

gremion.{tenantId}.content.channel.insta.description: Published when the Instagram channel dispatch for a content post has been enqueued (L3, disabled-by-default). Subject built by contentSubject(tenantId, 'channel.instagram.enqueued').

publishContentPublishSucceeded.summary: Content leaf publishes publish.succeeded when all channel dispatches complete.

publishContentPublishFailed.summary: Content leaf publishes publish.failed when publish attempt fails terminally.

publishContentChannelEmailSent.summary: Content leaf publishes channel.email.sent when email channel dispatch completes.

publishContentChannelPortalSent.summary: Content leaf publishes channel.portal.sent when portal channel dispatch completes.

publishContentChannelInstagramEnqueued.summary: Content leaf publishes channel.instagram.enqueued when Instagram dispatch is enqueued.

consumeContentEvents.summary: The module repo's audit consumer — not in this repo — subscribes on gremion.*.content.> (6+ token subjects). At-least-once delivery; consumers MUST dedupe on eventId.

eventId.description: Also the Nats-Msg-Id (JetStream dedup). Matches @gremion/ports EventEnvelope.eventId.

eventType.description: Short event type. Values: ContentEvent union from @gremion/ports/broker. Matches @gremion/ports ContentEvent.

tenantId.description: Tenant UUID (resolved by UUID per #173). Matches @gremion/ports EventEnvelope.tenantId.

correlationId.description: Content post UUID (the leaf's post id). Matches @gremion/ports EventEnvelope.correlationId.

payload.description: Event-specific payload (see envelope sub-schemas). Matches @gremion/ports EventEnvelope.payload.

externalRef.description: External reference from the most recent successful publish (e.g. kernel news_posts.id for portal).

channels.description: List of channel identifiers that succeeded (e.g. 'email', 'portal', 'instagram').

error.description: Human-readable error message from the terminal publish failure.

deliveredCount.description: Number of recipients successfully delivered to via email.

externalRef.description: The kernel news post id created/updated by the portal-publish callback (content_origin_post_id anchor).
